blocks.tamil_translation: made the sun a lamp (do you not see this too)? And “Allah caused you to grow from the (soil of the) earth as plants (like grass and herbs), then He will return you into it; and He will bring you forth (again) (from that very earth). Allah has made (this) earth a carpet for you - so that you may walk on its broad paths” (Nuh also said)

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۞ قَالَ رَبُّ السَّموتِ وَاْلاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ؕ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ ۞ قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ ۞ قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبآئِكُمُ اْلاَوَّلِينَ ۞ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ ۞ قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ؕ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (Then) Fir'awn asked, “And what is the Rabb of the worlds?” He said, “(He is) the Rabb of the heavens, the earth and whatever is between them - if you are people of certainty (then believe in Him).” He said to those around him, “Do you not hear (what he says)?” He said, “(And Allah) is your Rabb and the Rabb of your forefathers of old.” He said, “Surely your messenger who has been sent to you is a madman!” He said, “(He) is the Rabb of the east and the west and whatever is between them; if you are people who understand (then realise this and believe in Him).”

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قَالَ فَمَنْ رَّبُّكُمَا يَمُوسي۞ قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِي أَعْطي كُلَّ
